title: tracker interface (config tracker, adapters, the entries its commands print)
description: The tracker is the project's own system, reached through nine operations (ready, show, create, link, claim, close, reopen, defer, list). An adapter (adapters/<name>.json, or a path in the config) maps each operation to a shell command and says how its JSON output maps to the entry shape below. Placeholders in a command are shell-quoted by the runner; a part in [square brackets] that holds a placeholder is left out when that value is empty. Measure, build and merge never call the tracker.

ref.description: The tracker's own id of the entry.

assignee.description: The claim holder, when the tracker keeps one.

deps.description: Refs of the entries that block this one.

field.description: Where an entry field is in the tracker's JSON: a path (a.b, a[].b maps a list, a[k=v].b filters a list, a[0]), or {path, prefix, map}.

prefix.description: Put before the value (a GitHub number becomes #123).

map.description: Value to value, applied after the prefix.

config.description: The config's tracker object. Nothing is hard-coded: with no tracker the files adapter applies.

adapter.description: An adapter name (adapters/<name>.json) or a path to an adapter file, relative to the project root. Default files.

goal.description: Ref of the goal admission takes items from (ready(parent=goal)).

actor.description: The name the harness acts as in the tracker. Default: a hash of host and clone path, never a person.

commands.description: Overrides of the adapter's commands, by operation.

sha256.description: The tracker binary's sha256 for this platform when the adapter has none for it.

binary.description: Program on PATH whose sha256 is checked before any command runs.

types.description: The tracker's names for goal, feature and item.

commands.description: Operation to command template (a string; link may be an object by dependency kind, with default).

output.description: Operation to how its output is read: json (default), none, url-ref (the last path segment of a printed URL, with ref_prefix).

fields.description: Entry field to where it is in the tracker's JSON; an operation's own table under by_op wins.

states.description: The tracker's state names to open, in_progress, closed, deferred.

list_states.description: What {state} is for the wanted set: open, live (not closed), closed, all.

labels.description: Label conventions that stand in for a missing capability.

metadata_in_body.description: Metadata is kept as a marker comment at the end of the body (a tracker with no metadata field).

missing.description: A regular expression that the error text of a show matches when the ref no longer exists.

release.description: Command text the owner runs to free a stale claim, {ref} filled in; a fact lists it.

id_prefix.description: Prefix of the item id derived from a ref (<prefix>-<slug of the ref>).

deps_format.description: kinded: create takes kind:ref dependencies; blocks (default): create takes only blocking refs and the runner links the other kinds afterwards.
